name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog, joined Awin Feeds, and approved eBay listings; find verified deals and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.10.3 adds separate eBay Sandbox and Production modes plus a visible disclosure beside approved affiliate links. Sandbox never emits affiliate tracking, eBay credentials remain on Railway, seller identity remains explicitly unverified, and commercial relationships never affect ranking. The private Awin Feed List continues to discover joined US English Feeds and synchronize promotions, while Shopify Global Catalog remains the general catalog source. Node.js 24, evidence-aware matching, stable product selection, bounded provider normalization, and fail-closed schema handling remain in place. Authorized Chrome remains a bounded fallback after complete API search returns no usable product. The agent never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
